title: "Additional Overflights, 9-10 July 1956" – U-2 routes over Eastern Europe and USSR
description: Map titled "Additional Overflights, 9-10 July 1956" covering Europe from Scandinavia to Turkey, with country borders and capitals. Lines trace "Mission 2020 9 July 1956," "Mission 2021 9 July 1956" and "Mission 2023 10 July 1956" from West Germany across Poland, Czechoslovakia, Hungary and Romania into the Belorussian and Ukrainian SSRs, reaching Minsk, Kiev, L'vov, Kishinev, Simferopol' and Sevastopol'. Marked "Secret NOFORN" with handwritten page number "107."
